## e5525362bfb8

**Reproduced defect — the generator narrows an all-pairs rule to exactly two
pluses and rejects a canonical three-plus input.** The selected authority finds
every green plus center and connects every diagonal-aligned pair. Canonical
`train[2]` has centers `(2,2)`, `(5,5)`, and `(8,2)`, but the generator's
`self_check` returns `expected exactly 2 plus centers, got 3`, so this input is
outside its documented/generated domain. A plausible generator-induced rival,
“connect only the first two detected centers,” misses the second bridge at
`(6,4)` and `(7,3)`; the selected Racket output paints both cells red.

Evidence: `checks/audit/e5525362bfb8/counterexample.json` (generator SHA
`1773b335339a512d161732bf630a3f946deec1c5e169546f7c1d9f011f090366`, rule
hash `7aef5b5cd6e6`) and the supported apply receipt
`checks/audit/e5525362bfb8/racket.json`. The replay exited 0 and returned a valid
output. No audit-target files were modified.
